env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env sumdb=$BOLERO_SUMDB
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PROXY BOLERO_NOPROXY BOLERO_SUMDB BOLERO_NOSUMDB

# rejected proxy fails verification
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-503
! bolero get rsc.io/quote
stderr 503

# fetch through working proxy is OK
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy
bolero get rsc.io/quote

# repeated fetch works entirely from cache, does not consult sumdb
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-503
bolero get rsc.io/quote
rm go.sum

# fetch specific module can work without proxy, using cache or go.sum
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PROXY=off
bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2 # using cache
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/sumdb/localhost.localdev/sumdb/lookup/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2 # using go.sum

# fetch fails once we lose access to both cache and go.sum
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-504
! bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stderr 504

# BOLERO_INSECURE does not bypass checksum lookup
env BOLERO_INSECURE=rsc.io
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy/sumdb-504
! bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stderr 504

-- go.mod.orig --
module m
